decision: No sidebar in the Quartz registry; the shell is the top bar with three text links and a PageHeader per page
evidence: registry.json has 83 items and none is a sidebar; project-home block imports none

decision: Three row actions become two icon buttons plus a menu (re-process; menu: finish indexing, delete)
Delete asks in an alertdialog with a written destructive button instead of window.confirm
Boxes on the page image are kind-lined regions holding a stretched ItemLink to the passage detail; Quartz has no hotspot component
Passage types borrow the five kind hues so the row badge and its box match: text agent, table and row key, figure model, form deploy
The composer is PromptInput with the document scope Select in its tools slot; Stop ignores the late response
The answer is Response; an inline tag turns [n] into a Badge link to #source-n
DrawableViewer stays as the one custom region: Quartz has no pointer-drawing surface
Field boxes use the strong line, anchors the key hue dashed with a kind badge, a doubtful read the warn line and badge
Save template is secondary so Run template is the one primary on the view
